title: Admin creates a Junior plan price
description: Add a Junior category price to an existing club plan from Payment Plans. + Segment reuses the plan name (locked); you choose the Junior segment and set only the price. Junior must already be enabled under Segments.

steps.title: Payment Plans
steps.body: Club plans are managed under Admin → Payment Plans. Seeded Monthly membership already has a Regular price.

steps.title: Add a category price
steps.body: On Monthly membership, use + Segment to add another category price to the same plan — not a separate unrelated plan.

steps.title: Name stays the same
steps.body: The form shows Monthly membership. Name, kind, and duration are locked — you are adding a category to this plan, not renaming it.
steps.resultNote: Only Segment and Total price are editable.

steps.title: Select Junior category
steps.body: Choose Junior in the Segment dropdown. That is the member category this price applies to.

steps.title: Set Junior price
steps.body: Only the Total price is yours to change here. Enter the Junior amount (example $50.00).

steps.title: Save the Junior price
steps.body: Click Add price. Members in the Junior segment see this amount for Monthly.

steps.title: Junior price on Monthly
steps.body: Monthly membership now lists Regular and Junior. Players are charged the price for their member segment.
steps.resultNote: Junior category price on the same Monthly plan — one plan name, multiple category prices.
